dedupe_keys.name: independent aggregator market impact simulation settings and results

description: Kārlis Baltputnis and Zane Broka of Riga Technical University publish simulation settings and precomputed results for independent-aggregator participation in the Nordic day-ahead electricity market. The experiments examine price changes and welfare effects when new entrants participate in pay-as-cleared markets, including demand-response offers and compensation socialisation. The single ZIP archive contains main-run and sensitivity-run outputs in MATLAB and NumPy formats with Excel settings. The deposit is freely accessible from Zenodo under the MIT licence. The metadata links the Python implementation and an earlier MATLAB implementation as related software; neither is treated as this dataset’s primary identity. A limitation is that raw market bids and offers are excluded. The source says that the code retrieves historical aggregated curves from Nord Pool when run. Exact market dates, sampling intervals and spatial submarkets remain unknown, and no software was executed or market data obtained.
